body:
We’ve said it before, and we’ll probably say it a few hundred times again: making sure families have what they need to celebrate all of baby’s precious first moments is the heart and the center of everything we do. When we hear from families that dadada products have helped make their nurseries more beautiful, their sleep more comfortable, and their lives a little easier, we know we’re doing our job EXACTLY the way we hoped.

So you can imagine how thrilled we were to find ourselves on Babylist’s Best Cribs of 2021 list! We’re in great company with some wonderful designs, and it means a lot to us to be among the best. Decades of craftsmanship and experience are behind every piece we make today, and the traits recognized by Babylist are exactly what we work to provide for every family who purchases a dadada piece.

  1. We’re committed to safety. We’ve been awarded multiple certifications for our manufacturing and finish standards that go above and beyond the U.S. Consumer Product Safety requirements. Our products are not only safe for baby, but also better for the environment in your home, and our customer service makes sure and assembly questions or missing pieces are responded to quickly and thoroughly.
  1. We’re committed to making life easier for parents. dadada cribs are equipped with adjustable mattress settings to grow with your baby, have a small footprint to save space in your nursery, and all have the option to convert to a toddler bed with the addition of our conversion kit.
  1. We’re committed to quality that lasts. We don’t just want our pieces to help you make memories for the first couple years – we want you to hand them down through generations, accumulating hundreds of precious moments along the way. So we use our history of artisan furniture construction to make sure every piece is heirloom quality and built to last.

Thank you, Babylist, for recognizing how hard we work for parents! And thank you MOST of all to the families who have invited us in to their first few years with baby. The photos and memories and feedback you share mean the world to us, and we’re grateful every single dadaday. ;)
